% A report that defines a counter named appendix, with its own
% \theappendix, for its own numbered notes, and references to them and
% to the appendix chapters.
\documentclass{report}
\newcounter{appendix}
\renewcommand\theappendix{N-\arabic{appendix}}
\newcommand\note{\par\refstepcounter{appendix}Note \theappendix. }
\begin{document}
\chapter{Main}\label{main}
\note\label{note:a}Text of the first note.

Ref: \ref{note:a}; \ref{note:b}; \ref{app:a}; \ref{sec:a}; \ref{main}.
\appendix
\chapter{Extra}\label{app:a}
\section{More}\label{sec:a}
\note\label{note:b}Text of the second note.
\end{document}
